zh-CN.name: 动效驱动
zh-CN.description: 工作用交互方向：借助有目的的移动、出现和状态过渡表达关系、层级与操作结果。动效应服务任务，不能替代结构、说明或真实状态。
use_when: 静态变化难以表达前后状态或空间关系。
短暂过渡能帮助用户理解操作结果。
avoid_when: 不要强制等待装饰动画后才能继续任务。
持续装饰不能与反馈动效争夺注意力。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 先定义状态关系，再为切换、进入和反馈选择必要动效；允许中断和重复操作，旧动效在状态改变时清理；减少动态效果时用直接状态切换保留同样的信息。

en.name: Motion-Driven
en.description: A working interaction direction that uses purposeful movement, appearance and transitions to express relationships, hierarchy and outcomes. Motion must serve the task rather than replace structure, explanation or real state.
use_when: A static change does not clearly convey state or spatial relationships.
A brief transition can help users understand an outcome.
avoid_when: Do not force users to wait for decoration before continuing a task.
Continuous decoration should not compete with meaningful feedback.
en.prompt_template: Define state relationships first, then choose necessary motion for transitions, entry and feedback. Allow interruption and repeated actions, clean up obsolete motion when state changes, and preserve information through direct state changes when motion is reduced.
